assets.label: export transfer pumps
assets.service: tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family

control_failures.control_label: controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: OEM service bulletin affecting HTP-CLASS-A

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 2 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on P-7111, M-7111 and PT-7111 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically bunding, drainage and spill containment. P-7111 (export transfer pumps) is in service for tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 20 October 2011 the original equipment manufacturer issued an advisory affecting P-7111, M-7111 and PT-7111 at Cape Verity Export Terminal.
